statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let J := fun (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ → ℝ) => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (v u:ℂ)*S n (high n) u*S n (high n) u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → -(n:ℝ)/576 ≤ J n (fun t => 1-K n t)

plain_statement.zh: 开放瓶颈：移频平均回原频率的带符号修正
plain_statement.en: Open bottleneck: signed correction back to the original frequency

brief.zh: 权 1−K 在相位一致处变小。在这些频段用已有高段能量界；其余频段仍需单侧抵消。此权的非负性不能决定复被积函数实部的符号。
brief.en: Use the accepted bulk energy cap where the phases align and 1−K is small. Elsewhere one-sided cancellation remains. The sign of the real part is not determined by this nonnegative weight.
